channel.title: Wire — Engineering
channel.description: Engineering from thirty sources, one digest a day.

item.title: Presentation: Wrangling Telemetry at Scale: A Guide to Self-Hosted Observability
item.description: Colin Douch shares battle-tested strategies for building and scaling self-hosted observability stacks. (1 source: infoq)

item.title: Introducing the Cloudflare PHP Capture the Flag challenge
item.description: We are launching a PHP Capture the Flag challenge integrated with our Bug Bounty program to test our WAF protections. Security researchers are invited to bypass our defenses and capture the flag to help make the Internet safer. (1 source: cloudflare)

item.title: What took the Internet offline in Q3 2026
item.description: An examination of global Internet disruptions observed by Cloudflare Radar during the third quarter of 2026. This review analyzes how power failures, natural disasters, and government shutdowns impacted network connectivity and traffic. (1 source: cloudflare)

item.title: How the fastest-growing enterprises on Stripe scale globally
item.description: Despite slower global economic growth and greater geopolitical fragmentation, the fastest-growing enterprises continue to look beyond their home markets and are investing in tools and workflows that make expansion faster and more… (1 source: stripe)
